1: A narrow whitewashed Granada lane at dusk, skewed angular houses, hard low light: a lean, weathered Iberian man of about forty-two with deep-set dark eyes, dark brows, short dark curly hair touched with grey and a short dark beard, in a worn dark doublet, takes off his heavy faded cloak and holds it out with both hands to a ragged old beggar who sits against the wall, seen mostly from behind and in shadow; John's face is clearly visible in three-quarter view, gentle and unselfconscious, shivering a little in his shirtsleeves. No children.
3: The doorway of a small, bare sixteenth-century Granada house at dawn: a lean, weathered Iberian man of about forty-two with deep-set dark eyes, dark brows, short dark curly hair touched with grey and a short dark beard, in a worn dark doublet, stands in the open door with a heavy iron key in one hand, looking into the empty whitewashed room behind him, a few straw pallets rolled up against the wall, one shaft of hard light across the floor; his face clearly visible in three-quarter view, quiet and resolved. Nobody else in the shot.
4: A steep Granada street at dusk, skewed angular houses, mist: a lean, weathered Iberian man of about forty-two with deep-set dark eyes, dark brows, short dark curly hair touched with grey and a short dark beard, in a worn dark doublet, bends forward carrying a thin sick man across his back, the sick man's arms hanging over John's shoulders, his bare feet dangling, his face turned away and hidden; John's face clearly visible in three-quarter view, strained and tender, walking uphill toward a lit doorway. No children.
6: A dim stone room in a sixteenth-century bishop's palace, hard light from a tall window: a bishop in a dark cassock and a plain skullcap, seen in profile at the edge of the frame, holds out a coarse undyed wool habit; a lean, weathered Iberian man of about forty-two with deep-set dark eyes, dark brows, short dark curly hair touched with grey and a short dark beard, in a shabby dark doublet, kneels bareheaded before him, face clearly visible in three-quarter view, humble and astonished. Two men only.
8: The interior of a bare whitewashed sixteenth-century Granada house with straw pallets in rows, lantern light and hard shadows: a lean, weathered Iberian man of about forty-two with deep-set dark eyes, dark brows, short dark curly hair touched with grey and a short dark beard, in a plain coarse habit, kneels beside a sick man on a pallet holding a cup to his lips; in the open doorway behind him two ragged men stand hesitating with their caps in their hands, seen from the side. John's face clearly visible in three-quarter view, tender. No children.
